### Callout hardcoded for light
Notice. This callout hardcodes a white background with #333333 body text and an #e0e0e0 border. It never consults the page theme.

Muted secondary line at #666666 with no background set, so it sits directly on the message surface.

inline chip #444 on #f5f5f5 Normal themed prose follows for comparison.
